trimmedBy: node trim-captures.mjs (JSON.parse, whole-record selection by position in the 20-job page, regex redaction of e-mail addresses and separator-bearing phone numbers inside string values, JSON.stringify); never a byte cut
notes: Browse endpoint, second page (cursor taken from page 1 unchanged): 20 jobs captured, 3 kept; nextCursor retained as received. Terms (API Users clause): every Apply must use applicationLink; show a visible Himalayas credit/link; show jobs only on sites you operate (no passing to other boards/aggregators); cache; remove expired jobs. Clause 30A exempts use of the public API in line with its documentation and rate limits. robots.txt allows /jobs/api (only ?page= HTML listings are disallowed). Data is cached server-side and refreshed every 24 h. Observed drift from the documented schema: locationRestrictions are plain strings (documented as {alpha2,name,slug} objects) and timezoneRestrictions are numbers (documented as strings). E-mail addresses and phone numbers inside string values were replaced by a parser; personal NAMES in free-text descriptions cannot be found by a parser and were not redacted (records were chosen with short descriptions to limit exposure).
